//: PORTABLE: the ASSERTIONS block below is the family standard and ncs-astro-sanity-starter is the library of record for it. The `url` list is EXPECTED TO DIFFER per site: it names the pages this repo builds. Lighthouse CI runs against the built static output (dist/client) so dev-server quirks never affect scores. The url list is EXPLICIT on purpose: with staticDistDir alone, lhci auto-discovers pages but caps at 5, testing a near-random subset. Listing URLs covers every distinct template and skips non-page stubs. Accessibility is a HARD gate (must hold 100); performance / best-practices / SEO are warnings so normal CI variance does not block a PR. Not listed, on purpose: /studio, /preview/** and /api/draft-mode/* are SSR-only and never emitted into dist/client; /[slug] and /journal/[slug] build zero paths with no Sanity project configured; the nine module routes under modules/ are staged, not built. Add a representative URL per template as a project brings those online. Run locally: npm run build && npx lhci autorun
